visualCharacteristics: Three equal columns separated by thin vertical dividers, each a small bold heading over a stacked list of blue chevron links.
contentPattern: One row, one cell per column; each cell = small heading + list of links.

structure.note: One row, one cell per column; each cell = small heading + list of links.

usage: Equal columns separated by vertical dividers, each with a small heading followed by a list of links.
reuseGuidance: Use for documentation or resource link directories. Put each link in its own paragraph or list item. Use columns for image/text layouts.
